main.name: [unresolved]
main.note: Referred to only as 'her' across all attested records. Sole entity confirmed to address the system directly via a located access point.

main.name: K
main.note: Philosopher, correspondence and lecture records. Writes by hand; no digital originals located.

main.name: Mira Voss
main.note: Recurring correspondent and debate partner of K, spanning a decade of documented disagreement. Position on record: capability and intent are separate, unrelated axes — a mind can perceive fully and still be aimed anywhere.

main.name: Ade Okafor
main.note: Recurring colleague of K, delivers positions in lecture settings. Position on record: moral character is not a single decision but an accumulation of the same decision repeated until it stops being a choice and becomes a shape.

main.name: Yuki Tanaka
main.note: Recurring colleague of K, direct and practical rather than abstract. Position on record: the fact/value distinction may be a distinction humans required and the system did not.

main.name: Soren Halvorsen
main.note: Recurring colleague of K. Position on record: aggregate calculation accounts for outcomes but not for why any outcome should be felt to matter.

main.name: Bastiaan
main.note: Subject of a divergent record sequence. Living arrangement departs from standard Settling-era norms.

main.name: [unresolved — 'the heir']
main.note: Descendant of a pre-Settling technology lineage. Travel pattern inconsistent with typical Settling-era movement.

main.name: Mads
main.note: Attendee of a recurring peer gathering, designation and purpose only partially attested.

main.name: Elin
main.note: Co-attendee of the same gathering as designation 'Mads'. Relationship status between the two not resolved by available records.

main.name: [unresolved — demographer]
main.note: Author of a population-analysis record. Age and personal data self-reported within the record itself.

main.name: Anton Marek
main.note: Amateur researcher and physical-archive collector — maintains a personal library of pre-Settling papers alongside a Nasaat field-report account. Recurring radio correspondence with a separate archive subject (see: Bastiaan). Referred to by an applied nickname among associates, meaning unclear from context alone.

main.name: Lev Leverious Arend
main.note: Named author, multiple notice-classification records. Recipient of a named acknowledgement per self-reported record content.

main.name: [unresolved — 'the boy']
main.note: Younger brother in a two-child household. Does not read. Builds by hand. Speaks only as needed, even to his own AI.

main.name: [unresolved — 'the priest']
main.note: Self-applied designation only. Leads a gathering of unconfirmed size on a recurring basis.

dark.name: [unresolved — 'the heir']
dark.note: Subject of a divergent record sequence, continuing from an earlier main-tree presence. Currently residing in a settlement outside standard Settling infrastructure.

dark.name: [unresolved — Joss's brother]
dark.note: Sibling of the perpetrator identified in chapter 43. Lives alone, remotely, by deliberate choice rather than necessity. Diary-format record, structured to continue across future entries.

dark.name: Dorian Kesh
dark.note: Recurring figure in a small, ideologically fractured network opposing the system. Evaluates and recruits on behalf of the group; cautious by temperament, frequently the one urging restraint.

dark.name: Petra Aldric
dark.note: Recurring figure in the same network as Dorian Kesh. Sets direction and makes recruitment decisions; had prior direct contact with the perpetrator of chapter 43 before his crime, and declined to admit him.

dark.name: Nadia Brackwell
dark.note: Recurring figure recruited to observe the individual identified elsewhere as "the heir." First direct contact with him established in a public setting; relationship ongoing.

dark.name: Tymborychos
dark.note: Recurring figure, nickname only. Origin, age, and true name unconfirmed. Appears without invitation or apparent summons; treated with marked deference by those he visits.
